entities.summary: Anwar Sajjad, more commonly known as Enver Sajjad was a Pakistani playwright and fiction writer. Because he was a novelist, playwright, actor, director, producer, voice-over artist, columnist, painter, dancer and physician, he has been described as a polymath.
